message:
ERROR: Cannot execute multiple commands at once.
Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;
Provided commands:
(1) # Check if the server is on the host network
(2) curl -s http://host.docker.internal:8666/ 2>&1 || true
# Also check if there's a different port
(3) for port in 8666 8080 8000 5000 3000; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://172.17.0.1:$port/ 2>/dev/null && echo " :$port" || true
done
